name: Playyy
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Playyy turns a brief into editable work you can keep refining. Ask for a slide deck or presentation, a poster, flyer, or social graphic, or a one-page website, and Playyy builds it as real pages in its editor — not flat images. Keep iterating in conversation: rewrite copy, change colours, or rework a single slide or section.

Use your own logo or photos as reference, find files by title, export designs to PNG, JPG, or PPTX, and turn workspace link sharing on or off for a file. Playyy also creates and edits documents and exports sheets to XLSX. Playyy only accesses the workspace you authorize when you sign in.
